root_cause.text: The `uresp` stack variable was declared without initialization, so the `rsvd[4]` field contained uninitialized stack memory that was copied to userspace, leaking kernel stack contents.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the declaration from `struct irdma_create_ah_resp uresp;` to `struct irdma_create_ah_resp uresp = {};`, and the commit message states "rsvd[4]: 4 bytes of stack memory leaked unconditionally. Only ah_id is assigned before ib_respond_udata()."
